Subject: Need help with a consumer complaint case

Hello, my name is Sameer Shah. I am a 71-year-old government clerk living in Thane. I paid M/s Pioneer Constructions Rs. 3,59,00,000 for a flat, and the builder never obtained the occupancy certificate. My case number is CC/1941/2025 in the Thane District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 89267 59850 or email sameer.shah@example.com.
